claims.text: Oral calcitriol (w oral Ca) to suppress secondary HPT; results variable in ESRD
claims.quote: Although oral calcitriol is often given along with oral calcium to suppress secondary hyperparathyroidism, the results are variable in patients with end-stage renal disease.

claims.text: Parenteral calcitriol or paricalcitol may better prevent it
claims.quote: The parenteral form of calcitriol or vitamin D analogs such as paricalcitol may better prevent secondary hyperparathyroidism in such patients
